24.0.en: Nobody wanted a flashy [[casino:casino]] or a noisy photo [[studio:studio]]; they longed for warm meals.
24.0.zh: 没人想要花哨的赌场或吵闹的照相馆，大家只惦记热乎的家常饭。

24.1.en: Though the town grew more [[urban:urban]] every year, their own alley stayed [[quiet:quiet]] and almost [[peripheral:peripheral]], like a dream.
24.1.zh: 尽管镇子一年年变得更像城市，他们那条小巷依旧安静，几乎被人遗忘，像一场梦。

24.2.en: Shops in the near [[vicinity:vicinity]] closed early, leaving the [[night:night]] street an empty [[void:void]].
24.2.zh: 附近的店铺早早打烊，夜里的街道空得像一片空白。

24.3.en: After we cleared away the [[junk:junk]], the hall looked [[spacious:spacious]] yet still dusty, far from [[airtight:airtight]] and safe.
24.3.zh: 清走废旧杂物后，大厅宽敞了些，可还蒙着灰，远算不上密封安全。

25.0.en: Mingming ran across the wide [[expanse:expanse]] toward the small front [[plaza:plaza]], shouting with joy.
25.0.zh: 明明跑过宽阔的空地，冲向门前小广场，高兴地大喊。

25.1.en: He imagined the house as a storybook [[castle:castle]], and then the old [[carpenter:carpenter]] appeared.
25.1.zh: 他把老屋想象成童话里的城堡，这时老木匠正好出现。

25.2.en: The careful [[mason:mason]] tapped each loose floor [[tile:tile]], humming an old village [[tune:tune]].
25.2.zh: 细心的泥瓦匠敲了敲每块松动的地砖，嘴里哼着村里的老调子。

25.3.en: By [[sunset:sunset]], fresh grey [[brickwork:brickwork]] along the doorway promised many busy mornings ahead.
25.3.zh: 到日落时，门口新砌的灰砖墙预示着往后一个个忙碌的清晨。

26.0.en: Mingming woke with a sharp [[appetite:appetite]], eager to help Mom [[cater:cater]] for tomorrow's guests.
26.0.zh: 明明饿着肚子醒来，迫不及待要帮妈妈为明天的客人备餐。

26.1.en: They checked the stored food, keeping only fresh [[edible:edible]] things as a [[provision:provision]] for the week.
26.1.zh: 他们检查了存粮，只留下新鲜可吃的，作为一周的储备。

26.2.en: Grandma shared a secret [[recipe:recipe]], planning to turn the old hall into a small [[restaurant:restaurant]].
26.2.zh: 奶奶拿出一个秘方，打算把旧厅堂改成一家小饭馆。

26.3.en: Unlike the school [[refectory:refectory]] or the noisy street [[bar:bar]], home food would be [[gentle:gentle]] and warm.
26.3.zh: 不像学校食堂，也不像街上吵闹的酒吧，家里的饭菜温和又暖心。

26.4.en: They refused the dull [[cafeteria:cafeteria]] lines and the costly hotel [[buffet:buffet]] for the big dinner in the hall.
26.4.zh: 厅里那顿大餐，他们既不要冷清的自助食堂排队，也不要昂贵的酒店自助餐。

26.5.en: Uncle Wang offered his yard [[barbecue:barbecue]] stand, freeing the family [[supper:supper]] from dull routines.
26.5.zh: 王叔把院子里的烧烤架贡献出来，让家里的晚饭不再老一套。

27.0.en: Grandma dreamed of a [[harvest:harvest]] [[banquet:banquet]], with warm tea as [[refreshment:refreshment]] for every child.
27.0.zh: 奶奶梦想摆一场丰收宴，给每个孩子都备上热茶点心。

27.1.en: Mingming packed a quick [[snack:snack]] and, for a [[first:first]] taste, a tiny [[appetiser:appetiser]] for the road.
27.1.zh: 明明装了一份快手小吃，还带上一小份开胃菜先尝尝，准备路上吃。

27.2.en: Mom praised the village [[cuisine:cuisine]], refusing greasy street [[takeaway:takeaway]] boxes that [[night:night]].
27.2.zh: 妈妈夸村里的菜式好，那晚没要油腻的街头外卖。

27.3.en: A retired [[chef:chef]] nearby smiled, calling Mingming a little [[gourmet:gourmet]] with a refined taste.
27.3.zh: 附近退休的老厨师笑了，夸明明是个嘴刁的小美食家。

27.4.en: They also cooked for a [[vegetarian:vegetarian]] aunt, borrowing clean extra [[cutlery:cutlery]] from the neighbors.
27.4.zh: 他们还为吃素的姨妈做了菜，向邻居借来干净的多余餐具。

27.5.en: Mom sliced a thin [[sliver:sliver]] of melon and served soup in blue [[ceramic:ceramic]] bowls.
27.5.zh: 妈妈切下薄薄一片甜瓜，用蓝色陶瓷碗盛汤。

28.0.en: Grandma lifted the white [[porcelain:porcelain]] plates, setting a small flower [[saucer:saucer]] under each cup.
28.0.zh: 外婆托起白瓷盘，在每个杯子下面垫上小花茶碟。

28.1.en: Mingming carried a [[wooden:wooden]] [[tray:tray]] and a [[mug:mug]] of warm milk without spilling a drop.
28.1.zh: 明明端着木托盘和一大杯温牛奶，一滴都没洒。

28.2.en: Mom filled the black [[kettle:kettle]] and scrubbed the deep [[iron:iron]] [[pot:pot]] until it shone.
28.2.zh: 妈妈灌满黑色水壶，把深铁锅刷得锃亮。

28.3.en: Uncle Wang checked the old [[stove:stove]] flames and cleaned the cold brick [[furnace:furnace]] behind it.
28.3.zh: 王叔查看旧炉子的火苗，又清理了后面冷冰冰的砖熔炉。

28.4.en: They warmed bread in the [[clay:clay]] [[oven:oven]] and stored rice in a sealed [[tin:tin]].
28.4.zh: 他们在土烤箱里热面包，把大米存进密封的锡罐。

28.5.en: Mingming pressed the loose [[jar:jar]] [[lid:lid]] down [[tight:tight]], then poured Grandma a hot pear [[beverage:beverage]].
28.5.zh: 明明把松动的罐盖压紧，又给外婆倒了一杯热乎乎的梨子饮品。

28.6.en: Afterwards Mingming tied his red [[trainer:trainers]] and ran down to the shop.
28.6.zh: 忙完后，明明系好红色运动鞋，一路跑去了小店。

28.7.en: There he and Uncle Wang [[refurbish:refurbished]] an old chair with fresh paint.
28.7.zh: 他和王叔用新漆把一把旧椅子翻修一新。

29.0.en: They refused all [[alcohol:alcohol]] and cheap [[fruit:fruit]] [[liquor:liquor]] at the family table.
29.0.zh: 家宴上他们不碰任何酒，也不喝便宜的果酒。

29.1.en: Uncle Wang hid his [[whisky:whisky]] bottle and his sweet [[brandy:brandy]] away from the children.
29.1.zh: 王叔把威士忌酒瓶和甜甜的白兰地都藏起来，不让孩子们碰到。

29.2.en: Nobody arrived [[drunk:drunk]] for dinner, though an old [[tobacco:tobacco]] smell lingered in the coats.
29.2.zh: 没人带着醉意来吃饭，只是外套上还留着些陈年的烟味。

29.3.en: Grandma threw away a wet [[cigarette:cigarette]] end, keeping her head clear and [[sober:sober]].
29.3.zh: 外婆扔掉湿漉漉的烟头，让头脑保持清醒沉稳。

29.4.en: At [[dawn:dawn]] they picked green [[pea:pea]] pods and crisp long [[cucumber:cucumbers]] in the garden.
29.4.zh: 天刚亮，他们就在园子里摘了青豌豆荚和又脆又长的黄瓜。

29.5.en: Mom picked firm [[round:round]] [[cabbage:cabbage]] heads and shiny [[purple:purple]] [[eggplant:eggplants]] for the stew.
29.5.zh: 妈妈挑了结实的圆白菜和发亮的紫茄子，准备炖菜。

30.0.en: Mingming pulled up orange [[carrot:carrots]] and [[flat:flat]] white [[turnip:turnips]] from the soft soil.
30.0.zh: 明明从松软的土里拔出橙色的胡萝卜和扁扁的白萝卜。

30.1.en: He washed each little [[radish:radish]] clean, then helped Grandma [[peel:peel]] apples for lunch.
30.1.zh: 他把每颗小萝卜洗干净，又帮外婆削苹果准备午饭。

30.2.en: Mom taught him to [[strip:strip]] off wilted leaves and keep the soft yellow [[core:core]] inside.
30.2.zh: 妈妈教他剥掉枯叶，留住里面软黄的菜心。

30.3.en: They cracked open the [[rough:rough]] [[seed:seed]] [[hull:hull]], tasting one red wild [[berry:berry]] after another.
30.3.zh: 他们敲开粗糙的籽壳，一颗接一颗地尝红色野莓。

30.4.en: Mingming traded two bunches of [[purple:purple]] [[grape:grapes]] for two soft, sweet [[papaya:papayas]].
30.4.zh: 明明用两串紫葡萄换回两个又软又甜的木瓜。

30.5.en: Grandma dried red [[plum:plum]] slices in the sun, thanking the autumn [[crop:crop]] for its lavish gifts.
30.5.zh: 外婆晒着红色李子干，感谢秋天庄稼的丰厚馈赠。

31.0.en: Uncle Wang carried golden ears of [[corn:corn]] and heavy [[grain:grain]] sacks into the yard.
31.0.zh: 王叔把金灿灿的玉米和沉重的粮袋扛进院子。

31.1.en: They ground the pale [[wheat:wheat]] kernels, remembering how farmers [[reap:reap]] under the hot sun.
31.1.zh: 他们磨着淡色的麦粒，想起农民顶着烈日收割的模样。

31.2.en: Mom mixed white [[flour:flour]] with water and cooked thick morning [[porridge:porridge]] for everyone.
31.2.zh: 妈妈把白面粉和水调匀，给全家煮了浓浓的早粥。

31.3.en: Mingming stirred the sticky rice [[paste:paste]], watching the village [[livestock:livestock]] crowd up to the fences.
31.3.zh: 明明搅着黏黏的米糊，看着村里的家畜挤到栅栏边来。

31.4.en: They chose a fat farm [[chicken:chicken]] and a stately brown [[turkey:turkey]] for the [[feast:feast]].
31.4.zh: 他们为宴席挑了一只肥硕的农家鸡和一只气派的棕色火鸡。

31.5.en: Mom bought prime pink [[beef:beef]] slices and fresh low-fat [[pork:pork]] from a vendor she trusted.
31.5.zh: 妈妈从信得过的摊主那里买了上好的粉牛肉片和新鲜低脂猪肉。

32.0.en: Grandma seasoned the dark [[mutton:mutton]] chunks, adding a long smoked [[sausage:sausage]] for extra flavor.
32.0.zh: 外婆给深色的羊肉块调味，又添一根长长的烟熏香肠提味。

32.1.en: Uncle Wang netted a silver [[fish:fish]] from the clear [[pond:pond]] behind the bamboo grove.
32.1.zh: 王叔从竹林后那口清亮的池塘里网起一条银鱼。

32.2.en: He carved a new fishing [[rod:rod]] and traded fresh milk and [[dairy:dairy]] food with the neighbors.
32.2.zh: 他削了一根新鱼竿，拿新鲜牛奶和乳制品跟邻居们交换东西。

32.3.en: Mingming tasted the thick white [[yogurt:yogurt]] and spread soft yellow [[butter:butter]] on his bread.
32.3.zh: 明明尝了浓稠的白酸奶，又把软黄的黄油抹在面包上。

32.4.en: At noon they shared a warm [[hamburger:hamburger]] and a crusty [[loaf:loaf]] of brown bread.
32.4.zh: 中午他们分吃了一个热汉堡和一条脆皮黑面包。

32.5.en: Mom baked a [[round:round]] apple [[pie:pie]] and boiled thin long [[pasta:pasta]] for the children.
32.5.zh: 妈妈烤了一个圆圆的苹果派，又给孩子们煮了细细长长的意面。

33.0.en: Grandma twirled the long [[spaghetti:spaghetti]] into little nests and chilled sweet milk [[pudding:pudding]] for dessert.
33.0.zh: 外婆把长长的意大利面卷成一个个小巢，又把甜牛奶布丁冰镇着当甜点。

33.1.en: Mingming crunched a square [[biscuit:biscuit]] and spread red strawberry [[jam:jam]] thick on his bread.
33.1.zh: 明明嘎吱咬着方形饼干，往面包上厚厚地抹了红草莓酱。

33.2.en: They churned cold [[ice cream:ice cream]], adding fragrant pale drops of [[vanilla:vanilla]].
33.2.zh: 他们搅打冰凉的冰淇淋，滴进几滴芳香的淡色香草。

33.3.en: Mom passed round the strong yellow [[mustard:mustard]] and a tiny dab of green [[wasabi:wasabi]] with care.
33.3.zh: 妈妈小心地递上呛口的黄芥末酱，还有一小撮青芥末。

33.4.en: Uncle Wang crushed the black [[pepper:pepper]] grains and sliced the pale yellow [[ginger:ginger]] [[root:root]] thinly.
33.4.zh: 王叔碾碎黑胡椒粒，又把淡黄的生姜根切成薄片。

33.5.en: Mingming minced the white [[garlic:garlic]] cloves and long green [[scallion:scallions]] for the soup.
33.5.zh: 明明把白蒜瓣和长长的青葱剁碎，准备下汤。

34.0.en: They sprinkled a few drops of clear rice [[vinegar:vinegar]] and added a small pinch of white [[salt:salt]].
34.0.zh: 他们洒了几滴清亮的米醋，又捏进一小撮白盐。

34.1.en: Grandma loved the [[mild:mild]] [[fruit:fruit]] [[flavour:flavour]], not the sharp [[sour:sour]] taste of unripe plums.
34.1.zh: 外婆喜欢温和的果香，不喜欢没熟的李子那股冲鼻的酸味。

34.2.en: Mingming spat out the [[bitter:bitter]] skin and reached for the warm soup instead, [[mild:mild]] and [[spicy:spicy]].
34.2.zh: 明明吐掉发苦的皮，转身去喝那碗温和又带辣味的热汤。

34.3.en: The guests called the stew [[delicious:delicious]] and said the warm buns were simply [[yummy:yummy]].
34.3.zh: 客人们夸炖菜美味，还说热腾腾的馒头好吃极了。

34.4.en: The hot noodles were [[tasty:tasty]], just right for [[thirsty:thirsty]] workers after a long day.
34.4.zh: 热面条真够味，正适合干了一整天活、口干舌燥的工人。

34.5.en: Mom ground red [[spice:spice]] powder, simmering a thick tomato [[sauce:sauce]] slowly.
34.5.zh: 妈妈磨好红色香料粉，又慢慢熬着浓浓的番茄酱。

35.0.en: Mingming squeezed wavy lines of red [[ketchup:ketchup]], while the roses nearby gave off [[natural:natural]] [[perfume:perfume]].
35.0.zh: 明明挤出弯弯的红番茄酱条，旁边的玫瑰散发着天然香气。

35.1.en: Grandma counted every fresh [[ingredient:ingredient]], adding a herbal health [[supplement:supplement]] for the elders.
35.1.zh: 外婆数着每样新鲜食材，还给长辈们添了一份草本补品。

35.2.en: Warm soup helps the elders [[digest:digest]] well, so Mom chose to [[bake:bake]] soft cakes for lunch.
35.2.zh: 热汤帮助老人消化，所以妈妈决定中午烤些松软的小饼。

35.3.en: Uncle Wang helped [[fry:fry]] golden potato shreds, then watched Grandma [[roast:roast]] chestnuts slowly.
35.3.zh: 王叔帮忙煎金黄的土豆丝，接着看外婆慢慢烤栗子。

35.4.en: They served crisp morning [[toast:toast]], warning the children not to [[suck:suck]] the hot soup too fast.
35.4.zh: 他们端上清晨脆脆的烤面包片，提醒孩子们别急着去嘬滚烫的汤。

35.5.en: Mingming learned to [[swallow:swallow]] his food calmly, refusing to [[lick:lick]] his fingers at the table.
35.5.zh: 明明学会了安安静静地咽下饭菜，饭桌上再也不舔手指。

paraZh.24: 拒绝赌场照相馆，清走杂物大厅变宽敞。
paraZh.25: 跑向广场迎木匠，瓦匠补砖黄昏新墙立。
paraZh.26: 饿醒备餐查存粮，秘方开饭馆烧烤添彩。
paraZh.27: 梦丰收宴备前菜借餐具，陶碗盛汤待客忙。
paraZh.28: 备齐瓷器锅灶热面包，系鞋去店翻修旧椅。
paraZh.29: 家宴不沾酒藏酒瓶，清晨摘豆挑菜备炖汤。
paraZh.30: 拔萝卜剥菜心尝野莓，葡萄换木瓜晒李子干。
paraZh.31: 扛玉米磨麦煮粥搅糊，选鸡买肉备足宴席。
paraZh.32: 腌羊肉网鱼做鱼竿，尝酸奶分面包烤派煮面。
paraZh.33: 卷面冰布丁抹果酱打冰淇淋，切姜剁蒜备汤料。
paraZh.34: 洒醋捏盐品果香喝辣汤，客人夸赞熬番茄酱。
paraZh.35: 挤番茄酱数食材烤小饼，炸土豆烤栗学礼仪。
